title.en: Types of government and democratic variations

text.en:
The class debated who should make decisions for a school trip.
"Different governments decide differently," said the teacher.

Governments can be classified by who holds power. In a monarchy a king or queen rules, in a dictatorship one person holds power by force and in a democracy the people choose.
Democracies vary: in a direct democracy people vote on laws themselves, while in a representative democracy like India they elect representatives. India is also a republic, where the head of state is elected, not hereditary.
Governments get their power from the people and have duties to protect rights and provide services.
